posts.text:
Visited the Community Foundation of the Texas Hill Country yesterday to check on the progress being made to rebuild Kerr County after last year’s devastating floods.

Recovery efforts continue to move forward. More than 50% of residents who lost homes or suffered major damage have now been rehoused or completed repairs. More than 600 small businesses are also trending in the right direction.

There is still work to do, but the resilience of this community remains remarkable.

#HillCountryStrong
